subject: Request for VM evidence: scan cadence, SLA, and CVE remediation attestation (Solara Finance)
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <e.zhang@solarafin.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Mehta <rajiv@procure.solarafin.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vulnerability management evidence request - Solara Finance

Hi Sean,

As part of our SIG/SOC2 intake for Redwood, our security team is collecting primary artifacts for vulnerability management. Can you provide:

- A brief statement of scan cadence (tools, frequency, scope) for public-facing and internal services
- Current SLA commitments or target timelines for CVE remediation by severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low)
- An attestation or letter that we can include in our audit package confirming the above and referencing your SOC 2 controls (if applicable)
- Any recent scan summary (last 90 days) and an index of evidence files we can attach to our SIG response

I've attached our SIG template for convenience (Solara expects this by 2026-09-22 COB). If that deadline is tight, please let me know and we can extend by a few days.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20m call to walk through items.

Emily Zhang
Security Program Manager
Solara Finance
security@solarafin.com

Attachment: solara_sig_template_filled.xlsx (template with questions)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <e.zhang@solarafin.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vulnerability management evidence request - Solara Finance

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear ask and the template. We're on it. High-level answers below and we'll follow up with attachments and a formal attestation PDF by 2026-09-21 EOD (per your window).

Quick answers (summary):
- Scan cadence: Combination of authenticated network scans + image/registry static scans and integrated SCA on CI. Public endpoints scanned weekly, internal infra scanned every two weeks, container images scanned on every merge to main (CI).
- SLA targets for remediation (we'll include formal wording in the attestation): Critical: 7 business days; High: 30 calendar days; Medium: 90 calendar days; Low: tracked and remediated as capacity allows.
- We'll provide a 90-day scan summary PDF, an index CSV of evidence artifacts, and a signed attestation letter referencing SOC2 control mappings.

@Kimberly — can you export the scan summary and evidence index and drop into the shared Drive folder?
@Laura — can you draft the attestation with the SLA wording above and a brief line mapping to SOC 2 relevant controls (CC6.1/CC6.2 equivalent)?

Emily — if helpful, Mateo (copied on thread for visibility) can join a short call to review the artifacts once uploaded.

Sean Gallagher
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vulnerability management evidence request - Solara Finance

Sean / Laura — working on exports. Quick status:

- Generated a 90-day aggregated scan summary (results scrubbed for customer-sensitive IPs) -> redwood_scan-summary-q3-2026.pdf (attached)
- Produced an evidence index (artifact list with timestamps, scanner IDs, and links) -> redwood_vm_evidence_index.csv
- Collected remediation tickets for CVEs referenced in the summary; I'm proposing we include a short rollup (top 10 CVEs, status, fix ETA) rather than full ticket dumps for Solara's SIG package.

Question for Laura: do we want to include the raw CSV of all findings, or a summarized PDF only? For audit depth, they sometimes request both.

Also: attaching a draft internal note on the remediation SLA language — I used the targets Sean suggested but added a short exception carveout for 3rd-party vendor patches.

Attachments: redwood_scan-summary-q3-2026.pdf, redwood_vm_evidence_index.csv

Kimberly Park
Security Operations Manager
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft: CVE remediation attestation and SLA language

Thanks Kim — saw the index and summary, looks good. I've drafted an attestation (attached) we can sign and deliver. Highlights and small edits I've included inline:

- SLA / remediation targets (final language):
  - Critical (severity: CVSS >=9 or active exploit / P0): Remediation target 7 business days from identification or proof-of-concept confirmation; immediate mitigations and customer notification if external exposure is confirmed.
  - High (severity: CVSS 7-8.9): Remediation target 30 calendar days; exceptions documented when a mitigation is applied pending vendor patch.
  - Medium (severity: CVSS 4-6.9): Remediation target 90 calendar days; risk accepted with compensating controls possible.
  - Low: Tracked and remediated as per normal release cycles.

- SOC 2 mapping: We reference control areas relating to vulnerability scanning and patching procedures (internal control mapping included in the attestation appendix).
- Exceptions: We explicitly call out third-party library/vendor patch windows and coordinated disclosure timelines as possible exception lanes.

Kimberly — include the top-10 CVE rollup in the attestation appendix (redacted where necessary), and we should avoid attaching raw ticket exports to the customer-facing PDF. We can provide raw records through an NDA or auditor handshake if Solara requests deeper forensic proof.

I've attached cve-remediation-attestation-2026-09.pdf (DRAFT). If no major edits, I'll finalize and sign by EOD and upload to the Drive.

Laura Bennett
Head of Security Compliance
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Included (customer package):
- cve-remediation-attestation-2026-09.pdf (signed PDF attestation referencing SLA targets and SOC 2 mappings)
- redwood_scan-summary-q3-2026.pdf (90-day aggregated scan summary, customer-scrubbed)
- redwood_vm_evidence_index.csv (index of artifacts and timestamps — links included in Drive)
- solara_sig_template_filled.xlsx (your original template with our answers in the relevant tabs)

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleRedwood/Solara-VM-Evidence
HubSpot: DEAL-7890 (I've attached the Drive link to the record for tracking).

A few notes:
- The attestation contains remediation targets we observe in production: Critical 7 business days, High 30 days, Medium 90 days. These are our operational targets; exceptions for third-party vendor patches are listed in the attestation appendix.
- For auditors requiring raw ticket exports, we can provide them under an NDA / auditor access arrangement — please advise if you need that level of detail.

Would you like a 20-minute walkthrough of the package tomorrow? I'm available 09:00–12:00 PT.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
